lesson: The normalisation S(x) -> -1 (gamma growth) plus a maximum principle for the Potapov-Ginzburg transform forces any J-contractive multi-delay section into the unipotent family, so matrix freedom gives nothing. The first-moment no-go needs only the functional equation and a Schwarz-Pick bound on the coefficient pairing, not multiplicativity: it holds for DH too. Pointwise torus bounds are the wrong tool here (the integrand minimum is 1 - kappa^2/pi_P and would go negative for large P, while the bracket stays positive).
